answer: Standing decays sharply after 6 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The haven decay curve is applied at each close, bridge records the drop, and river recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks therefore finds them worthless when it returns to them. The attacker spends 65 dollars and 2 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
